page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-32 is a general-purpose virtual machine configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon processor operating at 2.2 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with two threads per core, the CPU configuration includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.25 MB of L2 cache, and 55 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates support for AVX, AES cryptography, and BMI2 instruction sets, though it lacks AVX-512 extensions. The server includes 128 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with the instance, requiring attached network persistent disks, and zero hardware GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Benchmark measurements indicate middle-tier multi-threaded throughput alongside lower single-core execution speeds. The system achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 2685.48, placing in the top quartile, whereas the Geekbench single-core score of 934.0 reflects lower single-thread execution efficiency. Multi-threaded evaluations demonstrate sustained capacity, registering 42996.45 in stress-ng multi-core and 8295.0 in Geekbench multi-core. PassMark tests produced a CPU mark of 38099.23 and a database operations score of 12626.08. In memory-intensive scenarios, read bandwidth reached 98.83 GB/sec on large blocks and write throughput sustained 44.29 GB/sec. Data processing tasks showed average throughput across multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 55.52 GB/sec and static web serving at 18.06 GB/sec, while single-threaded compression speeds remained modest.

The e2-standard-32 offers resource-dense compute and memory allocation suited for horizontally scaled infrastructure and parallelized tasks. Because single-thread execution efficiency is limited compared to compute-optimized platforms, the instance is most cost-efficient when handling multi-threaded services that can fully saturate its 32 vCPUs without requiring local NVMe IOPS. Common suitable deployments include medium-to-large relational databases, distributed caching layers such as Redis clusters, enterprise CI/CD compilation jobs, batch data pipelines, and high-concurrency web application serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-32 is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical Intel Xeon cores running at 2.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 128 GB of system RAM, it maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation. The platform omits integrated local storage and GPU hardware, relying on persistent network storage for data retention. Benchmark tests demonstrate consistent mid-tier performance across multi-threaded applications, recording a PassMark CPU score of 38099.23, Geekbench multi-core score of 8295.0, and 21.98 million Redis SET operations per second, offset by lower single-threaded compression and text processing results. The system offers balanced capacity for multi-threaded services that do not mandate high single-core clocks or extreme I/O throughput. It is functionally aligned with workloads such as enterprise web application tiers, medium-scale relational databases, distributed caching, software compilation, and parallel ETL batch processing.
